priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Resolved under the caller ruling. The quick-fix stream records `ruling-023` deciding `strict-read-purity-supersedes-first-touch-recovery`. Current code keeps `messages.listMessages` and `messages.show` inside `runWithThreadTouchSuppressed` (`src/domains/messages/index.ts:255-260`, `src/domains/messages/index.ts:323-328`). The retained recovery test now asserts a read leaves queued work untouched, then explicit `work.drain` recovers it (`test/work-execution.test.ts:237-277`), and the Story 1 read-purity test asserts background list/show make zero provider calls and leave raw work/forms unchanged (`test/messages-read.test.ts:336-372`).

Resolved. `test/red-manifest.json` now carries updated hashes for `test/work-execution.test.ts`, `test/messages-read.test.ts`, and `test/cli-process-inspect.test.ts` (`test/red-manifest.json:19`, `test/red-manifest.json:44-45`). The quick-fix log records `node scripts/record-red-manifest.mjs` for those three files, and `pnpm run green-verify` passed with `test-immutability: OK (43 Red-phase files unchanged)`.

newFindings.title: Configured epic gate still fails on a process-suite timeout
newFindings.evidence: The required epic gate `pnpm verify-all` failed when rerun by itself. Red-verify passed first (`build`, `typecheck`, `lint`, and `boundaries` all passed), but the process suite failed with `test/cli-process-report-repair.test.ts:118` timing out after Vitest's 5000ms default in `requeue through both owners returns identical result JSON on drained twins; the no-op and refusal legs match too`. A focused run of `LHC_PROCESS_SUITE=1 pnpm exec vitest run test/cli-process-report-repair.test.ts` passed in 3.47s, so the test behavior is available in isolation, but the configured `pnpm verify-all` gate is not green.
